item.title: fix(gateway): revalidate node command policy at the transport handoff…
item.summary: fix(gateway): revalidate node command policy at the transport handoff (#128576) The registry-owned isDispatchAuthorized gate runs after the async pairing-lease revalidation, immediately before the invoke frame is sent. Both node.invoke dispatch sites (raw handler and plugin-policy transport wrapper) computed the command allowlist decision before calling registry.invoke and only rechecked runtime approval authority in the closure, so a config reload that revoked the command during the lease await still dispatched it. Re-resolve the allowlist from live runtime config inside the closure so late revocations fail closed without dispatch. Pins added for previously untested invariants: pairing is validated before any policy evaluation (unpaired callers cannot probe deny reasons), a pairing-store failure during admission or during the registry lease recheck fails closed with UNAVAILABLE and no dispatch, and the new closure denies dispatch after a mid-flight policy change. Each new test was verified to fail on the pre-fix code for the intended reason. Assessment of Microsoft's Lobster patch 0046 via giodl73-repo/lobster-plugins-and-patches.
